role: Independent read-only review; not author of contrast revisions

findings.observed: Concentration-change stem supplies no concentration/flow relationship to interpret; prudent multifactor answer competes with explicitly retaining old parameters or ignoring concentration/access. Caution cues identify the answer without understanding iodine delivery.
findings.requiredCorrection: Replace with a self-contained hypothetical concentration/flow relationship task with homogeneous plausible numerical or mechanistic alternatives, specific wrong feedback and equivalent DE/EN/FA card. Explicitly distinguish the calculation from a universal patient injection prescription.
findings.retestEvidence: Read six revised question/card locale units including all distractor feedback. Correct arithmetic 300×3=900 mgI/s, 900/400=2.25 mL/s; homogeneous numerical options, language/units/key preserved, hypothetical-only boundary explicit.

findings.observed: Neonatal explanation frames ESUR first-week testing versus ACR routine screening as a difference without ESUR current qualification that thyroid testing is universal/routine in European countries.
findings.requiredCorrection: State that timely routine first-week screening can fulfil ESUR too and that no automatic duplicate test is implied. Preserve the accurate first-week ESUR and routine-screening ACR attribution in DE/EN/FA.
findings.retestEvidence: Read revised DE/EN/FA keyed option, complete explanation, D feedback and matching lesson callout/Take Home. Timely routine screening may fulfil first-week recommendation, no automatic duplicate sampling. Matches actual ESUR2026 paragraph.

findings.observed: Diagram properties repeat topic/group metadata, sometimes identical words on both sides of an arrow, rather than an educational relationship.
findings.requiredCorrection: Remove generic diagram properties without deleting clinical card fields, sources or IDs; no fabricated replacement diagram.
findings.retestEvidence: Current canonical producer has zero diagram properties across all29 cards. Clinical fields and IDs retained; unaffected13 pairs exactly unchanged.

sources.actualDocument: Official current 2026 PDF linked by ACR landing page
sources.read: NSF classification and elective HD scheduling; individual renal risk assessment; metformin/AKI and route qualifiers; thyroid history versus storm; pregnancy and neonatal screening. Current groups must not be inferred from linear/macrocyclic structure alone.
Current agent risk groups, macrocyclic versus linear dialysis guidance, pregnancy, first-week neonatal screening context, metformin and manifest hyperthyroidism. Group terminology differs from ACR.
2025 ACR/AAAAI recommendations 6–9: severe immediate prior reaction, alternatives first, unavoidable same-class use requires qualified precautions. No elimination-of-risk claim.
Injection contraindications explicitly narrow-angle glaucoma and prostate hypertrophy with urinary retention.
Indications distinguish route and age; pharmacodynamics describe blood echogenicity enhancement. Broader CEUS physics additionally checked against AIUM.
Low-MI real-time contrast-specific nonlinear detection, tissue suppression, high-MI destruction/replenishment distinction and agent/application constraints.

clinicalResult: No other confirmed key error, polarity inversion or meaning-changing DE/EN/FA disagreement identified within the 15 pairs. This is bounded item review, not whole-site scientific approval.
